name: M3DocVQA
description: M3DocVQA is a new benchmark for evaluating open-domain document visual question answering (DocVQA) over 3,000+ PDF documents with 40,000+ pages. It supports multi-page and multi-document understanding with multi-modal evidence including text, charts, and figures.
typical_sota_score: 70–80% (accuracy; varies by model and the specific subtask within the benchmark)
reputation: A newer but notable DocVQA benchmark that extends evaluation to multi-page, multi-document settings with richer evidence types than many earlier datasets.
notes: Designed for multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation in DocVQA, handling multi-hop questions and multi-document contexts.
